description:
Create a new document in AiDocX. The content is rendered to a professionally formatted PDF (A4, proper margins) and stored in document management.

Supported document types:
- contract: Contracts, NDAs, employment agreements, service agreements
- proposal: Project proposals, consulting proposals
- quotation: Price quotes, cost estimates, invoices
- plan: Project plans, strategy documents
- business-plan: Investor pitch business plans, startup plans
- business-trip-plan: Travel plans with itinerary and budget
- business-trip-report: Post-trip reports with outcomes and expenses
- report: Analysis reports, audit reports, due diligence
- official-letter: Official letters, notices, requests
- resume: Resumes, CVs, cover letters
- purchase-order: Purchase orders, delivery notes, invoices
- manual: SOPs, user manuals, guides

IMPORTANT: Before calling this tool, you MUST confirm the following with the user:
1. Document type (e.g., contract, quotation, resume, proposal)
2. Key details (parties, terms, items, or sections depending on type)
3. Any special requirements or clauses

Generate professional, well-structured HTML appropriate for the document type. Do NOT include <html>/<head>/<body> wrapper — only the inner content.
- Contracts: include signature blocks at the bottom
- Quotations: include item tables with totals
- Resumes: include profile, experience, education sections
- Proposals: include executive summary, scope, timeline, pricing

documentType.description: Document type. Determines formatting and structure. Default: 'contract'
